item.title: Robert Trujillo, Zakk Wylde Back Robbie Williams in Ozzy Osbourne’s “No More Tears” Tribute
item.description: The 2026 BRIT Awards close with an Ozzy Osbourne tribute as Robbie Williams takes the mic and Robert Trujillo delivers the thunder on “No More Tears.”

item.title: The Week in Bass: Historic Jazz Bass Drama, Prog-Jazz Heat, and Boutique Craftsmanship
item.description: Bootsy Collins’ 1969 Fender Jazz Bass is back on the market, the Spirit Fingers Trio delivers a blazing performance, and Bryant Trenier’s upright-inspired fretless acoustic steals the spotlight. Catch up on this week’s biggest bass stories.

item.title: February 2026’s Biggest Bass Gear Stories: The Top 10
item.description: February brought a wave of new bass gear as we explored NAMM 2026 highlights. Here are the 10 most-read bass gear stories on No Treble for February 2026.

item.title: Federico Malaman Trio Brings Warmth and Melody to “Song for Marco”
item.description: A new live performance from Federico Malaman’s trio highlights “Song for Marco,” with melodic piano and a wide, polished bass tone throughout.

item.title: The Carbonetti Guitars "Bowery" Bass Is What Happens When Vintage DNA Gets Reimagined
item.description: Built in Brooklyn, the Carbonetti Bowery Bass pairs mahogany warmth, custom humbuckers, and striking turquoise fret markers.

item.title: Nathan East to Anchor Eric Clapton’s 2026 Midwest Tour
item.description: Nathan East will once again hold down the low end as Eric Clapton returns to the Midwest this fall for a six-date U.S. tour with Jimmie Vaughan.

item.title: BOSS Launches GX-1B Bass Multi-Effects Pedal with 130+ Effects at $229
item.description: The new BOSS GX-1B bass multi-effects pedal offers AIRD amp modeling, 130+ effects, Bluetooth streaming, and flexible power options in a compact design.

item.title: Gorillaz Reveal 2026 North American Tour Featuring Live Bassist Seye Adelekan
item.description: Gorillaz have announced their first extensive North American tour in four years behind the new album The Mountain. The arena run features bassist Seye Adelekan in the live band, with support from Little Simz and Deltron 3030.

item.title: Watch Jacob Umansky Rip Through Intercval's “Lacuna” on the Dingwall Sol Signature Bass
item.description: Jacob Umansky demos his Dingwall Sol Signature at NAMM 2026 with a full playthrough of Intervals’ “Lacuna,” all clank, clarity, and control

item.title: This G Major Bass Exercise Will Push Your Left-Hand Stretch to the Limit
item.description: Bassist Marek Bero shares a challenging Bass Gym exercise in G major designed to strengthen your left hand, expand your reach, and unlock new interval possibilities on the fretboard.
